[[File:TuskCatCup.jpg|thumb]]
'''Tusk-cat memorial cups''' were vessels for drinking made on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. When tamed [[Tusk cat|tusk-cats]] died, the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] would cut off their tusks and carve them into such cups. Those would be displayed in Naboo dwellings or public buildings for ceremonial purposes, and were presumably used to drink as well.

==Behind the scenes==
This mimics real life use of [[Wikipedia:Drinking horn|drinking horns]] in Europe from Classical Antiquity to the Middle Ages.
